summary: Bound operational list views with pre-built SQLite projections and crash-safe DAG wiring (#335)

architecture.decision: Materialize stripped operational JSON payloads eagerly in SQLite ticket_operational during rebuild/apply, read via non-blocking WAL RO snapshots, add incremental cache eviction plus coalescing and byte limits for operational queries, avoid _ticket_model_cache growth on durable streaming, handle post-write TicketIndexContentionError cleanly, and reconcile external inverse edges across all plan candidates.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit on main; disposable ticket_operational index table and API cache/fallback helpers cleanly revert with zero durable YAML/store schema impact.

nonGoals: Changing canonical YAML/JSONL ticket storage formats
Returning unmasked stale projections when require_fresh=true
delivery.outcome: Repeated 1000-row operational pollers serve pre-built indexed projections with bounded memory/CPU without 500s on concurrent ticket creation, and interrupted bundle materializations cleanly repair inverse blocker edges.

validation.evidence: Verified ticket_operational parity across rebuild, apply, legacy upgrade, and non-blocking RO reads under concurrent write lock.
Verified operational poller serves stale last complete index, coalesces 8 concurrent misses into one build, populates bounded _TICKET_LIST_LATEST, and respects require_fresh=true and 413 byte caps.
Verified durable streaming path serves paged operational/summary/full views without populating store._ticket_model_cache.
Verified POST /tickets returns 201 derived_index_degraded on post-write TicketIndexContentionError and 503 on pre-write contention.
Verified interrupted materialize_bundle replay repairs inverse blocks edges without duplicate tickets.
